verdict.rationale: Jules can be delegated a task from a GitHub issue by applying the "jules" label. That is close to the story but is not tagging the agent in a conversation to discuss the work. Chat-tool integration (Slack, Linear) exists only as something you build yourself with the API, which supports sending messages to the agent, and one community member dispatched tasks from Copilot Chat via a self-built MCP server. Missing for 10: native @-mention tagging of the agent in a chat or issue thread, built-in Slack/Linear/Teams chat integration, threaded back-and-forth discussion inside the chat tool, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-thread delegation.
